name: Queen Esther
overview: The story of Queen Esther highlights God's providential care and the courageous faith of a young woman placed in a position of influence. Raised as an orphan by her cousin Mordecai, Esther found favor with King Ahasuerus and was made queen, demonstrating divine favor and grace (Esther 2:7, 2:17). Faced with the threat of destruction to her people, Esther exemplified bold obedience and sacrificial intercession by fasting and risking her life to approach the king without invitation (Esther 4:11, 4:14, 4:16). Her willingness to act 'for such a time as this' underscores the sovereign purpose behind her rise to royalty and the power of faith-filled courage in God’s deliverance (Esther 4:14, 5:1).
